zlib 1.3.1 (the zlib licence; see README and the notice at the top of zlib.h).
Source: https://github.com/madler/zlib/releases/download/v1.3.1/zlib-1.3.1.tar.gz
SHA-256 of the archive: 9a93b2b7dfdac77ceba5a558a580e74667dd6fede4585b91eefb60f03b72df23
The files are the upstream's, unmodified: deflate and inflate only (no gz*, no compress/uncompress).
They are built with Z_PREFIX (their names start with z_), by pc/core/kernel/sources.cmake.
